entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand Pulse. It's a piece of junk and I want my money back immediately.
I'm very sorry to hear you're not satisfied with your VeloBand Pulse. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To start, could you please provide your order number?
It's VF778-015B. And don't waste my time, just process the return.
Thank you. I have your order pulled up. Just so I can document this correctly, what specifically is the issue with the device? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?

Listen, I don't have time for a survey! The heart rate is wrong, the step count is a joke, and I want my money back. I've had it for 24 days. Don't you dare tell me it's **too late** or feed me some garbage line about **hygiene** and **sanitation**. Your company's **policy** is clear.

Of course. Let me just review that for you. One moment... Okay, I see here you received it on December 15th, which was 24 days ago. And you are absolutely right, sir. I'm checking our official knowledge base now.
It states that all items are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. So you are well within the timeframe for a full refund. I apologize for the trouble you've had.
See? I told you. Finally, someone who can actually read. So what now? Are you sending me a label or what?

Yes, I am processing the return authorization for you right now. I've just sent a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office.
Once the warehouse scans the return, the refund will be issued to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
